preconditions.description: The length of the string s equals the integer n provided in the first line of input.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s contains only the characters '(', ')', and '?'.
The length n is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == ':(' or (len(output) == n and all(c in '()' for c in output) and is_correct(output) and all(not is_correct(output[:i]) for i in range(1, n)))
postconditions.description: The output is either ':(' indicating no solution, or a string of length n containing only '(' and ')' such that the full string is a correct parenthesis sequence and no strict prefix is a correct parenthesis sequence.

postconditions.expression: output == ':(' or (output.count('(') == output.count(')') and all(output[i] in '()' for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output string has equal numbers of '(' and ')' and contains no '?' characters.
